scope.ends_at: producer-authored finalized collection is verified and all selected receipts are reconciled
scope.composition: both per-call and full-lifecycle bounds; final result does not waive intermediate custody checks

members.meaning: distinct intended output members, not repeated registrations

archive_units.meaning: units required by the declared canonical archive construction

explicit_links.meaning: declared direct member/provenance relationships, not expanded intermediate closure

index_domain.meaning: the relevant retained operational index population

fixed_conditions: finite successfully completed operation with no external failure; retries are separately declared below
cryptographic work factors, transfer segmentation and concurrency held fixed for growth comparison
identifier widths fixed by their contracts; other variable-length metadata charged in metadata_octets
maintained index assumptions and key-order profile identified in the cost model; comparison cost is not treated as constant

recovery_profile.normal_retry: repeat only the permitted uncommitted transfer/metadata work at its owning checkpoint; already confirmed ciphertext/receipts remain reusable
recovery_profile.loss_of_rebuildable_index: a separately measured/reasoned metadata-index rebuild may add its declared construction cost
recovery_profile.not_promised: finite completion under unlimited failures, or O(1) reconstruction of lost metadata indexes

delegates.obligation: matching upload/custody/finalization growth declarations must resolve before any end-to-end composite claim
bounded byte/object contact contract; provider-side elapsed latency is excluded, contacts and bytes remain counted

invariants: current authorization and claim/fence checks on the required boundaries
complete exact selected members and output identity
source release only after authenticated complete custody receipt
no hidden cardinality or payload-size ceiling
no data loss or omitted history to satisfy the cost bound

warning: Metric names and the expression grammar need one approved shared contract definition. This example is not an implementation, executed witness, or assertion that the existing client/server fulfills these bounds.
